 Studio

Studio is Bklit's interactive chart playground. Pick a chart, tweak styling and animation controls in real time, then copy the generated React code or export a registry JSON for your project.

 
 
 

Open Studio →

 Getting Started

See Installation for registry setup and all components.

 React Native (beta)

The line and area charts also run in React Native and Expo . They use the same components and props as the web charts, drawn with React Native Skia and animated on the UI thread with Reanimated: one-finger scrubbing, two-finger range selection, springs, morphs and the rolling date pill.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Try it on your phone 
 On Android, scan the code with your camera or open the install page , then tap Install. iPhone: coming soon on TestFlight.
 
 
 

Add the charts to an Expo app (with a components.json in the project root):

 

In an Expo project the CLI installs Skia, Reanimated and Gesture Handler with npx expo install , so you get versions that match your SDK. See the React Native guide for step-by-step setup.

Contributors can run the demo app ( apps/mobile , Node 22+) with pnpm dev:mobile and open it in Expo Go. See apps/mobile/README.md for publishing the demo builds.

install.html:
Bklit UI is a shadcn registry. Initialize shadcn in your project, then add a chart:

npx shadcn@latest init
npx shadcn@latest add @bklit/line-chart

See Installation for registry setup and all components.
